subject: expression: push down truncate to tiflash (#59318)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: only expression pushdown gating and related PB conversion test updates. `pkg/expression/infer_pushdown.go` now whitelists `ast.Truncate` for TiFlash when PbCode is one of `ScalarFuncSig_Truncate{Uint,Int,Real,Decimal}`; `pkg/expression/expr_to_pb_test.go` adds TRUNCATE cases to the Flash pushdown test set. No TRUNCATE evaluation semantics or type-inference logic changed in this commit; primary risk would be TiFlash-side signature/semantic mismatch, but there is no code evidence here suggesting an incompatibility, and no later history up to `upstream/master` changes this added Truncate support.
